items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: I played with three of the greatest pianists in the world. That was Art Tatum, Earl Hines, Duke Ellington.

ctx.x: I played with three of the greatest pianists in the world. That was Art Tatum, Earl Hines, Duke Ellington. I never played with Teddy Wilson. I tried to, you know, but I mean I did that.
We didn't talk about Earl Hines much. You toured with him didn't you?
Well, I even made an album with him at some club. Very good girl singer, she was with him a long time.

items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: listening to Duke Ellington, Earl 'Father' Hines. Those two people were idols, musically

ctx.x: And then one night there was a flood, and the next night there was no drums, no club, no nothin'. So that ended the drum career right there.
So, I still kept my ears glued to the radio, listening to Duke Ellington, Earl 'Father' Hines. Those two people were idols, musically, you know musically -- that was all you could hear.

I had made up my mind I was going to be a musician, but how? -- because I didn't have no musical learning. I didn't learn in school, they didn't have nothing to play. So I started foolin' around with the piano. I only could play in all the black keys. But that was all right, we got by. We had a little trio called Wynken, Blynken and Nod.
